name: SAP S/4HANA Cloud
description: Drive SAP S/4HANA Cloud Public Edition from any AI agent: business partners, customers, suppliers, sales orders, purchase orders, billing documents, products, journal entries. OAuth 2.0 client credentials from a communication arrangement, with the token from the tenant's own API host.
instructions:
**Setup (one-off, done by the S/4 admin)**:
1. In your S/4HANA Cloud tenant open **Communication Arrangements** and create one for *SAP_COM_0008 — Business Partner Integration* (and others as needed: 0109 Sales Order, 0026 Purchase Order, 0186 Billing).
2. Create a **Communication User** + **Communication System**. Pick **OAuth 2.0** as the authentication method, grant type **Client Credentials**.
3. Open the communication arrangement → **Inbound Communication** → **OAuth 2.0 Details**. It shows the **Client ID** and the **Token Service URL**, which is on the tenant's API host: `https://my300000-api.s4hana.cloud.sap/sap/bc/sec/oauth2/token` (your tenant ID replaces 300000). The client secret is the one set for that client, i.e. the password of the communication user. Do not use a BTP URL such as `https://<subaccount>.authentication.eu10.hana.ondemand.com/oauth/token`: S/4HANA Cloud does not accept tokens from a BTP subaccount on these APIs.
4. The **Base URL** is the same API host without a path: `https://my300000-api.s4hana.cloud.sap` (with `-api`; the address without it is the Fiori launchpad).
5. Set the four env vars below. Leave the scope empty: the token then carries what the arrangement grants.

**Auth header method**: Public Edition strictly requires Client ID/Secret sent via **HTTP Basic Authorization header** (not form fields). This adapter does that automatically.

**Token lifetime**: typically 1 hour. The connector engine refreshes proactively 5 min before expiry, single-shot client_credentials grant (no refresh_token needed).

**Generic OData tools**: besides the tools below, `s4_cloud_list_services`, `s4_cloud_describe_service`, `s4_cloud_describe_entity`, `s4_cloud_query` and `s4_cloud_get_entity` read the listed APIs' `$metadata`, so the agent can reach any field of those services with SAP's labels. A service outside the list needs its communication arrangement first.
prerequisites: An SAP administrator has to create a **Communication Arrangement** (e.g. SAP_COM_0008 for business partners, SAP_COM_0109 for sales orders) with a communication user and OAuth client. The four values below come from it.

S4_BASE_URL.label: API address
S4_BASE_URL.help: The API host of your S/4HANA Cloud tenant, with -api and without /sap/opu/odata: https://my123456-api.s4hana.cloud.sap.

S4_TOKEN_URL.label: Token URL
S4_TOKEN_URL.help: The Token Service URL shown under the communication arrangement → Inbound Communication → OAuth 2.0 Details. It is on the tenant's API host and ends in /sap/bc/sec/oauth2/token, not a BTP authentication.<region>.hana.ondemand.com address.

S4_CLIENT_ID.label: Client ID
S4_CLIENT_ID.help: The Client ID shown under OAuth 2.0 Details of the communication arrangement (its communication user).

S4_CLIENT_SECRET.label: Client secret
S4_CLIENT_SECRET.help: The secret of that client: the communication user's password.

verifyHints.401: S/4HANA Cloud refused the token request. Check: (1) the token URL is the Token Service URL from the communication arrangement → Inbound Communication → OAuth 2.0 Details, on the tenant's API host (https://<tenant>-api.s4hana.cloud.sap/sap/bc/sec/oauth2/token), not a BTP authentication.<region>.hana.ondemand.com URL; (2) the client ID and secret are those of the communication user of that arrangement's communication system; (3) a communication arrangement exists and is active for the service (e.g. SAP_COM_0008 for business partners); (4) no scope is set in the connector's OAuth settings, or only scopes the arrangement grants.
verifyHints.403: S/4HANA Cloud issued a token but refused the API call: no active communication arrangement covers this service for that communication user (e.g. SAP_COM_0008 for business partners, SAP_COM_0109 for sales orders), or the token was requested for another scope. Add the arrangement, or leave the scope empty.

tools.name: s4_list_business_partners
tools.description: List business partners (combined customers + suppliers) from API_BUSINESS_PARTNER.

tools.name: s4_get_business_partner
tools.description: Get one business partner by its 10-character ID.

tools.name: s4_list_customers
tools.description: List customer master records (subset of business partners).

tools.name: s4_list_suppliers
tools.description: List supplier master records (subset of business partners).

tools.name: s4_get_sales_order
tools.description: Get one sales order by its 10-char number.

tools.name: s4_list_sales_order_items
tools.description: List the items (line entries) of a given sales order.

tools.name: s4_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get one purchase order by its 10-char number.

tools.name: s4_list_billing_documents
tools.description: List billing documents (customer invoices, credit memos).

tools.name: s4_list_outbound_deliveries
tools.description: List outbound delivery headers (goods leaving the warehouse).

tools.name: s4_list_journal_entries
tools.description: List journal entry items (general ledger postings).

tools.name: s4_get_product
tools.description: Get one product/material by its ID.

tools.name: s4_list_purchase_requisitions
tools.description: List purchase requisition items (pre-PO demand requests).
